notes: Total 60 as published. The list renames cards as 'Phil' puns; each is dested to the card it stands for.

STARTING (9) as posted: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe ('Hunt Down And Destroy The Phil'), Executor: Holotheatre ('Holo-Phil-atre'), Visage Of The Emperor ('Visage Of The Phil'), Executor: Meditation Chamber ('Phil Chamber'), Epic Duel ('Epic Phil'), Prepared Defenses ('Prepared Phil'), Crush The Rebellion ('Crush The Phil'), Imperial Arrest Order ('Imperial Phil Order') and Mobilization Points ('Phil Points'); several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

Visage Of The Emperor is listed twice (once under STARTING as 'Visage Of The Phil', once under EFFECTS); both dested as posted. Unique characters posted x2 (Mara Jade, Mighty Jabba, Grand Moff Tarkin) are kept as posted.

Joke names dested: '4-LOM With Canceller' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Darth Vader With Glo-Stik' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Dengar With Elom Killer' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Emperor Phil' Emperor Palpatine; 'Shiny Grand Moff Tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Oppressive En-Phil-ment' Oppressive Enforcement.

Starships: 'Fett In Roadster' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Bossk In Bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckuss In Z-Train' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter. Weapons: 'Darth Vader's Saber' Darth Vader's Lightsaber, 'Vader's Saber' Vader's Lightsaber, 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.

Locations: 'Exec DB' Executor: Docking Bay; 'DS DB (not ds2)' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'CC DB' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay). Battle Order and Secret Plans are the older Effects (not Reflections III shields).
The description calls this 'a repost due to Decktech's recent problems'; no earlier copy of this list is in the archive.
